decisions.reason: Both allow self-inspections to be complemented by an additional audit.
Both allow quality audits to be extended to suppliers and contractors.
Both make the quality control head, with other departments, responsible for approving reliable suppliers.
Both require supplier evaluation before approval and listing.

decisions.addendum: The evaluation takes into account the supplier's track record and the nature of the materials it will supply.
decisions.reason: It adds what the supplier evaluation must take into account.
Both say a required supplier audit establishes the supplier's ability to comply with GMP.
Both require confirmation before release that the batch meets its licence or marketing approval.
Both require confirmation before release that the batch was made and controlled under the applicable GMP rules.
Same pre-release check that main manufacturing and testing processes are validated.
Same pre-release check on checks, tests, production conditions and records.
Same pre-release check that planned changes and deviations were notified, with authority approval where needed.
Same pre-release check on additional sampling and testing for changes and deviations.
Same pre-release check that production and QC documents are complete and endorsed.
Same pre-release check that audits, self-inspections and spot checks are done by trained staff.
Same pre-release check that the head of quality control has approved.
Same pre-release check that all relevant factors, including batch-specific ones, were considered.

decisions.item_text: Data may also be recorded by other means in parallel with the computerised system.
decisions.reason: No listed requirement covers recording data by other means alongside a computerised system.

decisions.item_text: The licensee has prepared a concise site master file with specific, factual GMP information on the production and/or control of the pharmaceutical products made at the licensed site.
decisions.reason: No listed requirement covers preparing a site master file.

decisions.item_text: The site master file includes general information: a brief company profile; the manufacturing activities authorised by the licensing authority; any other manufacturing done on the premises; the licensed product types with process flow charts; staff numbers in production, quality control, storage and distribution; any external scientific, analytical or technical support used for manufacture and analysis; products registered abroad; and brief outlines of the quality management system, the pharmaceutical quality system and quality risk assessment.
decisions.reason: No listed requirement covers the general information section of the site master file.

decisions.item_text: The site master file includes a personnel section: an organisation chart showing how quality assurance, production and quality control are arranged; the qualifications, experience and responsibilities of key staff; an outline of initial and ongoing training and how training records are kept; health requirements for production staff; and hygiene and clothing requirements.
decisions.reason: No listed requirement covers the personnel section of the site master file.

decisions.item_text: The site master file includes a premises section: a scaled plan or description of the manufacturing areas, the type of construction and the fixtures and fittings, and a brief description of the ventilation systems.
decisions.reason: No listed requirement covers the premises section of the site master file.

decisions.item_text: For critical areas where airborne contamination is a potential risk, the site master file describes ventilation in greater detail, including schematic drawings of the systems.
decisions.reason: No listed requirement covers detailed ventilation information for critical areas in the site master file.

decisions.item_text: The site master file states the cleanroom classification of each room used to make sterile products.
decisions.reason: No listed requirement covers stating sterile room classifications in the site master file.

decisions.item_text: The site master file also describes any special areas for handling highly toxic, hazardous or sensitising materials, gives a brief description of the water system with schematic drawings and its sanitisation, and describes the planned preventive maintenance programme for the premises and how it is recorded.
decisions.reason: No listed requirement covers these further premises items of the site master file.

decisions.item_text: The site master file includes an equipment section: a brief description and list of the major production and quality control laboratory equipment; the planned preventive maintenance programme for equipment and how it is recorded; and qualification and calibration, including how they are recorded and how computerised systems are validated.
decisions.reason: No listed requirement covers the equipment section of the site master file.

decisions.item_text: The site master file includes a sanitation section showing that written specifications and procedures are in place for cleaning manufacturing areas and equipment.
decisions.reason: No listed requirement covers the sanitation section of the site master file.

decisions.item_text: The site master file includes a documentation section: how documents are prepared, revised and distributed; the documents needed for manufacture; and any other product-quality documents not described elsewhere, such as microbiological controls of air and water.
decisions.reason: No listed requirement covers the documentation section of the site master file.

decisions.item_text: The site master file includes a production section: a brief description of production operations, using flow sheets and charts with key parameters wherever possible; how starting materials, packaging materials, bulk and finished products are handled, including sampling, quarantine, release and storage; how rejected materials and products are handled; and a brief outline of the general process validation policy.
decisions.reason: No listed requirement covers the production section of the site master file.

decisions.item_text: The site master file includes a quality assurance and control section covering the documentation system, change control, the validation master plan and validation policy, product quality review, a description of the quality control system and the work of the quality control department, and the procedures for releasing finished products.
decisions.reason: No listed requirement covers the quality assurance and control section of the site master file.

decisions.item_text: Where products are made under a loan licence, the site master file describes how the loan licensee's compliance with GMP will be assessed.
decisions.reason: No listed requirement covers describing loan licensee GMP assessment in the site master file.

decisions.item_text: The site master file describes the arrangements and recording system for distribution, and the arrangements for handling complaints and product recalls.
decisions.reason: No listed requirement covers the distribution, complaints and recall section of the site master file.

decisions.item_text: The site master file briefly describes the self-inspection system and states whether an independent, experienced outside expert took part in assessing the manufacturer's GMP compliance across all aspects of production.
decisions.reason: No listed requirement covers the self-inspection section of the site master file.

decisions.item_text: The site master file lists the products exported to each country and any complaints and product recalls related to them.
decisions.reason: No listed requirement covers the export section of the site master file.
It only allows certain published GMP guidance to be used for general orientation rather than requiring guidelines to be applied.

decisions.item_text: For phytopharmaceuticals, the technical parts of every contract are prepared by competent persons with suitable knowledge of the particular characteristics of these products, including how they are produced and tested in quality control.
decisions.reason: No listed requirement covers the competence of those drafting technical contract terms for phytopharmaceuticals.

decisions.item_text: For phytopharmaceuticals, at least one member of the self-inspection team has thorough knowledge of these products.
decisions.reason: No listed requirement covers phytopharmaceutical expertise on the self-inspection team.
